title: Carrow Coast Almanac — Fernhaven Seed Library
text: The Fernhaven Seed Library is a community seed-lending collection occupying the former lifeboat station on Quay Street, Fernhaven. It began lending seed to the public in early 2015 and has since built a catalogue drawn largely from members' own saved seed. Borrowing is free; members are expected to return seed from their harvests.
notes: Encyclopedia-ish register. Plants the second conflicting founding answer: 'began lending seed to the public in early 2015' — no shared wording with the other two, so only semantic grouping can put the three answers in one group.
